subject: DAY-TO-YYYYDDD function
notes: Verdict unchanged; supplies the missing spec-derived test. 'Evaluated as though 50 were specified' is an equivalence, asserted directly against the explicit-50 form. Argument-2 IS the windowing cut, so it is probed below it, AT it and above it (years 12/49/50/51/75) - a single sample on one side would pass while the windowing was wrong. The result VALUE is deliberately not pinned: 15.25.3 r5 defaults argument-3 to the current year, so the YYYY half is a clock reading; the DDD half is printed instead as the non-vacuity witness.
